description: The figure is a two-level (donut/sunburst-style) pie chart representing a breakdown of “Characters” into higher-level groups and their subcategories, showing a total of 2 inner slices and 13 outer slices. In the inner ring, “Virtual Characters” is shown as a large blue slice occupying roughly three-quarters of the circle, while “Real Characters” is a smaller green slice at about one-fifth, and there is also a small pink “Characters” slice at roughly a few percent. The outer ring subdivides the blue “Virtual Characters” portion into five light-blue categories—“Comic Characters” (the largest, roughly one-third of the full circle), “Game Characters” (around one-fifth), “Movie Characters” (around one-eighth), “Novel Characters” (around one-tenth), and “Teleplay Characters” (around one-twelfth). The green “Real Characters” portion is subdivided into seven light-green categories—“Influencers” (the largest of the green sub-slices, roughly ~5% of the full circle), “Actors,” “Musicians,” “Writers,” “Athletes,” “Artists,” and “Scientists” (each appearing as small, similar-sized slivers of roughly ~2–3% each). Labels are placed directly on or near slices, there is no separate legend, no numeric percentage annotations are shown, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized; the outer slices appear arranged around the circle without an explicit numeric ordering indicator beyond their visual placement.
